items.source: Returns the value of the given PersistentProperty of the underlying bean instance.
items.translation: 返回底层 Bean 实例中给定PersistentProperty的值。

items.source: A PersistentPropertyAccessor that will use an entity's PersistenceCreator to create a new instance of it to apply a new value for a given PersistentProperty. Will only be used if the PersistentProperty is to be applied on a completely immutable entity type exposing an entity creator.
items.translation: 一个PersistentPropertyAccessor，它将使用实体上的PersistenceCreator注解来创建该实体的新实例，以便为给定的PersistentProperty应用新值。仅当PersistentProperty将应用于一个完全不可变的实体类型（且该类型暴露了实体创建器）时，才会使用此功能。

items.source: Creates an InstantiationAwarePropertyAccessor using the given delegate accessorFunction and EntityInstantiators. accessorFunction is used to obtain a new PersistentPropertyAccessor for each property to set.
items.translation: 使用给定的委托函数 `accessorFunction` 和 `EntityInstantiators` 创建一个 `InstantiationAwarePropertyAccessor`。`accessorFunction` 用于为每个要设置的属性获取一个新的 `PersistentPropertyAccessor`。

items.source: Creates an InstantiationAwarePropertyAccessor using the given delegate accessorFunction and EntityInstantiators.
items.translation: 使用给定的委托 `accessorFunction` 和 `EntityInstantiators` 创建一个 `InstantiationAwarePropertyAccessor`。

items.source: Sets the given PersistentProperty to the given value. Will do type conversion if a ConversionService is configured.
items.translation: 将给定的 PersistentProperty 设置为给定值。如果配置了 ConversionService，则执行类型转换。
